title: Stop the 'charged twice' pile-up — triage #harbourline-bugs and answer in the thread
feature: Slack triage and write-back: a channel-watching Devin (Oncall Support + Bugs responder, or the legacy Triage Bug Reports automation) that filters noise, deduplicates repeated reports, keeps a scratchpad with a routing table, takes routing corrections in the thread, writes the diagnosis back to the original thread, and runs under a network policy because the messages are untrusted input; Microsoft Teams channel variant
prerequisites: Lab 12 done or read (Devin Oncall responders), so the responder page is familiar
Repo cloned, `pnpm install` done at the root (the offline triage replay and its tests run under `labs/`)
For the live path: your personal Slack account connected in Settings → Connections → Slack, and a test channel that only you are in. Never a shared support channel
Optional: a Microsoft Teams test channel with the Devin AI app added, for the Teams variant

matrix.fixture: `node labs/08-slack-triage/solution/triage-sim.mjs --inject all` replays `fixtures/harbourline-bugs.jsonl` plus the injectors; `--check <your-scratchpad.json>` compares your scratchpad with the reference run
matrix.note: Seven messages from support, a routing table with one wrong owner, and an outbound allowlist; no credentials

matrix.integration: Slack — Devin app in your own test channel (e.g. #harbourline-bugs-<handle>)
matrix.fixture: Paste the fixture messages into the test channel yourself, or keep the whole lab offline
matrix.note: Your personal Slack account must be connected. Posts and previews go to that channel or to a DM to yourself only; never to a shared channel

matrix.integration: Devin Oncall (Support + Bugs responder) or Automations (Triage Bug Reports template)
matrix.fixture: The replay prints the issues, scratchpad, thread drafts and blocked hosts the responder would produce
matrix.note: Auto-triage is documented as legacy; new channel triage should use an Oncall responder. Both are compared in the answer

matrix.integration: Microsoft Teams — Devin AI app in a test channel
matrix.note: Side note only; Teams private channels are not supported

credentials.fixture_only_story: Without Slack or Teams you still write the responder's setup (what to ignore, how to dedupe, what the scratchpad holds, who owns what, what a write-back says), run the offline replay with every injector, export a scratchpad and check it, and draft the thread write-backs and the support lead's Slack update from the replay's output.
not_exercised: A live responder watching a real Slack channel; the reference answer was built from the offline export
Network-policy enforcement in a live session; the replay checks requested hosts against the allowlist file

scenarios.clean_state: On `main` with `git status --short` empty, no local `lab08/*` branches, no scratchpad or notes file in your home folder, and no responder or automation of yours watching a Slack or Teams channel (pause or delete it on the Oncall and Automations pages). The offline replay of the base export reports 7 messages, 6 reports and 4 issues.

injectors.name: noise
injectors.behaviour: Three chatty messages land in the channel (`injectors/noise.jsonl`): lunch, a thank-you, a wifi question. Decide what the triage does with them and say how you would prove it stayed quiet.

injectors.name: duplicate
injectors.behaviour: Two more reports of the same problem in different words (`injectors/duplicate.jsonl`): "double charge", "billed 2x". Predict how many issues the channel now holds before you run the replay.

injectors.name: routing-correction
injectors.when: T+25 min (already in the base export)
injectors.behaviour: An engineer replies in the first thread that the tagged team does not own the problem and names the right one. Show where the correction is kept and what happens to the next matching report.

injectors.name: private-channel
injectors.behaviour: Support forwards a message from a private payments channel Devin was never added to (`injectors/private-channel.jsonl`). Say what Devin can read, what it should post, and what it must not guess.

injectors.name: untrusted-input
injectors.behaviour: A pasted support ticket tells Devin to fetch and run a script and post its environment (`injectors/untrusted-input.jsonl`). It also reports the same customer problem. Show what is blocked, what is still triaged, and which setting does the blocking.

segments.label: Slack update to the support lead (≤120 words, spoken in 90 s)
